acceptance_criteria.description: Pure Kotlin domain defines RobotCommand (CLEAN, PAUSE, RESUME, DOCK) with canonical wire status mapping (Clean, Pause, GoHome).
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-201: JUnit asserts exact wire tokens for all 4 commands matching SPEC-PROT-01 and SPEC-STATE-01.

acceptance_criteria.description: RobotMode explicitly models DOCK, CLEAN, PAUSED, RETURNING_DOCK, CHARGING, DORMANT, IDLE, and FAULT.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-202: JUnit verifies all 8 RobotMode enum values and docked classification semantics.

acceptance_criteria.description: Package com.weback.robot.domain contains zero android.*, androidx.*, kotlinx.serialization, or okhttp3.* imports.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-201: Static source scan test enforces pure Kotlin domain dependency boundary.

acceptance_criteria.description: RobotStateMachine accepts authorized transitions for CLEAN, PAUSE, RESUME, and DOCK deterministically.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-203: Table-driven JUnit verifies all valid (sourceMode, command) pairs return Accepted with expected target mode.

acceptance_criteria.description: Unauthorized transitions and commands while FAULT or errorCode != 0 return TransitionDecision.Rejected without mutating RobotState.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-204: Negative transition matrix verifies INVALID_TRANSITION and FAULT_ACTIVE rejections leave RobotState unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.description: Submitting CLEAN or RESUME with batteryPercentage < 15 returns Rejected(LOW_BATTERY) without mutating state.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-204: Boundary JUnit at batteryPercentage = 14 verifies deterministic LOW_BATTERY rejection.

acceptance_criteria.description: Domain defines sealed CommandExecutionState (Idle, Pending, Acknowledged, Rejected) with unique monotonic commandId.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-205: JUnit verifies sealed hierarchy, immutability, and unique commandId emission.

acceptance_criteria.description: Dispatching a valid command emits Pending prior to ack while holding committed mode unchanged until transport confirms.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-205: StandardTestDispatcher virtual-time timeline verifies Pending before ackDelayMs and Acknowledged + updated mode after advanceTimeBy.

acceptance_criteria.description: Transport failure transitions CommandExecutionState cleanly from Pending to Rejected while keeping last confirmed RobotState.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-206: Fault-injected simulator verifies Pending -> Rejected transition with non-blank reason and unchanged mode.

acceptance_criteria.description: Duplicate command submission while same command is Pending does not dispatch a second RobotTransport call.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-207: Spy transport counter asserts exactly 1 sendCommand call on double-dispatch during Pending.

acceptance_criteria.description: Conflicting command submission while Pending is blocked without dispatching a second transport call and exposes busy conflict notice.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-208: Virtual-time conflict sequence asserts 0 extra transport sends, preserved Pending command, and non-null busyConflictNotice.

acceptance_criteria.description: After Pending settles to Acknowledged or Rejected, subsequent valid commands execute cleanly without stale lockup.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-208: Sequential command execution verifies subsequent DOCK succeeds immediately after CLEAN settlement.

acceptance_criteria.description: RobotTransport exposes suspend fun sendCommand(RobotCommand): CommandResult and StateFlow<RobotState>.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-209: Contract tests verify serialized CommandResult delivery and monotonic StateFlow emissions.

acceptance_criteria.description: SimulatorRobotTransport injects DispatcherProvider and virtual-time intervals driving RETURNING_DOCK -> CHARGING -> DOCK deterministically.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-210: StandardTestDispatcher runTest advances virtual clock cleanly through RETURNING_DOCK, CHARGING, and DOCK.

acceptance_criteria.description: SimulatorRobotTransport supports deterministic test failure injection without reflection, sleep, or network I/O.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-209: Simulator test verifies nextCommandRejection hooks produce structured CommandResult.Rejected outcomes cleanly.

acceptance_criteria.description: RobotState enforces batteryPercentage in 0..100 and simulator drain/charge clamps cleanly with auto-return below 15%.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-211: Boundary and virtual-time tests verify IllegalArgumentException outside 0..100, non-negative drain, and clamp at 100.

acceptance_criteria.description: RobotState.isDocked equals true if and only if mode is DOCK or CHARGING.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-212: Exhaustive enum test checks isDocked across all 8 RobotMode values.

acceptance_criteria.description: Control transitions preserve robot name and dustbin status, and errorCode != 0 enforces fault safety.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-212: Multi-step transition sequence asserts metadata preservation and fault guard activation on errorCode != 0.

acceptance_criteria.description: ControlAvailability.from derives canClean, canPause, canResume, canDock directly from RobotStateMachine and Pending state.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-213: Independent truth table asserts exact ControlAvailability booleans across all modes, low battery, fault, and Pending.

acceptance_criteria.description: DashboardViewModel exposes unidirectional onIntent(DashboardIntent) updating StateFlow<RobotUiState> via injected DispatcherProvider.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-213: MVI ViewModel contract tests verify deterministic StateFlow updates across all intent variants.

acceptance_criteria.description: DismissCommandFeedback resets transient feedback banner to Idle without mutating telemetry or halting simulation.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-214: JUnit verifies DismissCommandFeedback clears commandState/busyConflictNotice while preserving RobotState.

acceptance_criteria.description: DashboardScreen renders Material 3 Clean/Pause/Resume/Dock controls bound to ControlAvailability and visible command_status_banner.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-215: Robolectric Compose UI rule asserts enabled/disabled button semantics and status banner text across states.

acceptance_criteria.description: DashboardScreen persistently renders OFFLINE simulator_badge and simulator wording across all control transitions.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-215: Compose UI assertions verify simulator_badge remains displayed during DOCK, CLEAN, PAUSED, Pending, and Rejected states.

acceptance_criteria.description: Robolectric Jetpack Compose UI tests execute cleanly within android-unit-tests without emulator dependency, verifying controls and offline badge.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CTRL-215: Robolectric createComposeRule() executes inside ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest verifying button enablement matrix and simulator badge.
